project.name: Customer Portal Modernisation
project.summary: Fabrikam modernises the Contoso customer portal and moves it to a managed cloud platform.
project.background: The current portal runs on an unsupported framework and cannot be scaled for seasonal peaks.
objectives: Reduce page load time below two seconds
Retire the legacy hosting platform by the end of the project

in_scope: Re-implementation of the order history pages

phases.name: Discovery
phases.description: Assess the current portal and agree the target architecture.

phases.name: Delivery
phases.description: Implement, test and hand over the modernised portal.

deliverables.name: Target architecture
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Approved by the Contoso architecture board.

deliverables.name: Modernised portal
deliverables.description: Production-ready portal on the managed platform.
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: All acceptance tests pass and page load time is below two seconds.

customer_dependencies: Access to the test environment by 2026-04-01
assumptions: The existing APIs remain stable during the project

pricing.expenses_policy: Pre-approved travel expenses are reimbursed at cost.
